# Security policy

Please don't report a vulnerability in a public issue or discussion.

Report it privately through GitHub: open the repository's [Security tab](https://github.com/realsamrat/gally/security/advisories/new) and choose "Report a vulnerability". Only the maintainer can see the report.

Say what is affected, how to reproduce it, and what an attacker could do with it. You'll get a reply as soon as the report has been read, and credit in the fix if you want it.

Gally is a client-side library, so the reports that matter most are ones where a photo URL, a photo's metadata or a prop can run script or load content the app didn't ask for.
